title: Lifetime Ban Imposed — Disproportionate Sanction Based on Disproven Allegations
category: International Aviation / Human Rights / Treaty Law
allegation_summary: LATAM-2 documents imposition of lifetime flight ban, including: (1) Lifetime ban based solely on disproven allegations of aggression; (2) Disproportionate sanction without consideration of severity or evidence; (3) Imposition without due process or review mechanism; (4) Violation of proportionality principles in sanctioning. This lifetime ban imposition violates: (a) Chilean consumer protection law prohibitions on disproportionate sanctions; (b) ICAO Annex 9 §8.15 requirements for proportionate sanctions with due process; (c) Principles of administrative justice requiring proportionality in penalties; (d) International standards on fair sanctioning in commercial relationships. The lifetime ban imposition demonstrates: (1) Institutional abuse of sanctioning power without evidentiary basis;
